title: I don't feel well
subtitle: Lucas has the flu — should and shouldn't
canDo: I can say how I feel and what's wrong.
I can give advice with should and shouldn't.
I can understand simple health advice.
teacherNotes: should = Türkçede "-meli/-malı" (tavsiye), Arapçada "من الأفضل أن / ينبغي". should'dan sonra to ve -s gelmez; en sık hata "should to".
Hastalık kelimelerini beden hareketleriyle öğretin (baş, boğaz, öksürük). Öğrenciler birbirine "What's wrong?" diye sorsun.
Kültür: herkesin ailesinin bir "ev ilacı" vardır (ıhlamur, limonlu bal, yansun çayı). Öğrenciler kendi ilaçlarını İngilizce anlatsın.
ABD'de "the flu" (grip) ile "a cold" (soğuk algınlığı) ayrımı yapılır; Türkçede ikisine de bazen "grip" denir.

sections.title: Read
sections.heading: Cold or flu?
sections.intro: A poster on the wall at Omar's hospital.
paragraphs: In winter, a lot of people get sick. But is it a cold or the flu?
A cold usually starts slowly. You have a sore throat, a runny nose and maybe a cough.
You feel tired, but you can usually go to work or school. After about a week, you feel better.
The flu starts suddenly. You have a high fever, a headache and pain in your whole body.
You're often too tired to get out of bed. The flu can last for one or two weeks.
You should stay at home and rest. Don't go to work or school: you can make other people sick.
You should drink a lot of water, tea or soup, and you should wash your hands often.
You shouldn't take antibiotics for a cold or the flu. They don't help.
When should you see a doctor? Call your doctor if you have a very high fever for more than three days, or if you can't breathe well.

sections.title: Grammar: should and shouldn't
look: You **should drink** a lot of water.
rules: **should** + verb, without *to*: *You should rest* (not *should to rest*).
**should** is the same for everyone: *I should, he should, they should* (no -s).
Use **should** to give advice. It means "it's a good idea".
examples: He shouldn't drink so much coffee.

support.tr: should = "-meli/-malı" (tavsiye): You should rest = Dinlenmelisin. Olumsuz: shouldn't = "-memeli/-mamalı": You shouldn't go out = Dışarı çıkmamalısın. should'dan sonra fiilin yalın hâli gelir: to yok, -s yok (He should rest). Soru: Should I …? = …-meli miyim?
support.ar: should = «من الأفضل أن / ينبغي» للنصيحة: You should rest = من الأفضل أن ترتاح. النفي: shouldn't = «لا ينبغي»: You shouldn't go out = لا ينبغي أن تخرج. بعد should يأتي الفعل بدون to وبدون ‎-s‎ (He should rest). السؤال: Should I …? = هل ينبغي أن …؟

wrong: You should to stay in bed.

ar.note: لا نضع to بعد should، والفعل بعدها بدون ‎-s‎.

sections.title: Write: Get well soon

model.heading: A message for Lucas — Elif
text: Omar says you have the flu. I'm so sorry!
You should stay in bed today and tomorrow, and you shouldn't worry about the test. Maya says you can take it next week.
You should drink a lot of tea with lemon and honey. That's my grandmother's medicine!
And you shouldn't play the guitar all night. Your roommates need to sleep too.
